DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 大きな城の図を見ていらっしゃいますね。どの部分の説明をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.translation: You are looking at the large castle diagram. Which part would you like explained?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: この図を見て、昔の建物が今も全部残っていると思いました。案内の「復元想像図」はどういう意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.hintJa: 図を現存建物と思ったと説明し、復元想像図の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.translation: Looking at this diagram, I thought all the old buildings were still standing today. What does “imagined reconstruction” in the description mean?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you thought the diagram showed surviving buildings, and ask what “imagined reconstruction” means.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: この展示では、当時の様子を資料から想定して描いた図という意味です。今ある建物をそのまま描いたものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.translation: In this exhibit, it means a drawing that imagines how it looked at the time based on historical materials. It is not a drawing of the buildings exactly as they stand today.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 現在の姿とは違うのですね。隣の古い写真と同じ場所を描いたのかも、説明から読み取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.hintJa: 図は現在の姿ではないと理解し、隣の古写真と同じ場所か説明から確かめられるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.translation: So it is different from its present appearance. Can the explanation also tell us whether it shows the same place as the old photograph beside it?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand the diagram is not the present view, and ask whether the explanation confirms it is the same location as the old photograph.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 図と写真の対応は、この番号表に載っています。ただ、一致が確認できない部分もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.translation: The correspondence between the diagram and photograph is listed in this number table. However, some parts have not been confirmed to match.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 番号で確かめます。図と写真を両方撮って帰れば後で比べられると思ったのですが、撮影の印が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.hintJa: 対応番号で確認すると伝え、図と古写真の撮影印の違いを指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.translation: I will check using the numbers. I thought photographing both the diagram and photograph would let me compare them later, but their photography symbols are different.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the matching numbers and point out that the diagram and old photograph have different photography symbols.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 図は撮影可能の印で、古写真のほうは撮影不可です。並んでいても、資料ごとの表示に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.translation: The diagram has a photography-permitted symbol, while the old photograph has a photography-prohibited symbol. Even when items are side by side, please follow each item's sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 古写真は撮らず、図だけにします。対応する番号をメモして、写真の代わりに配布の解説を持ち帰れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.hintJa: 古写真を撮らず図だけ撮り、番号のメモと持ち帰り解説で代替できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.translation: I will photograph only the diagram, not the old photograph. Could I note the corresponding numbers and take home the explanatory handout instead of photographing it?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will photograph only the diagram, not the old photo, and ask whether notes of the numbers and the take-home explanation can be used instead.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: この配布紙はお持ち帰りいただけます。図の番号は載っていますが、古写真自体の複製は入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.translation: You may take this handout home. It includes the diagram numbers, but it does not contain a reproduction of the old photograph itself.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 複製がないこともわかりました。図の番号と未確認の部分をメモして、解説と一緒に見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.hintJa: 配布紙に写真複製がないと理解し、番号と未確認部分を記録して解説と見直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.translation: I understand that there is no reproduction. I will note the diagram numbers and the unconfirmed parts, then review them together with the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand the handout has no photo reproduction and will record the numbers and unconfirmed parts to review with the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.sourceJa: では解説を一部お渡しします。撮影する際は図だけが入るようにし、通路を空けてご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-04-001-SHAR.translation: Then I will give you one copy of the explanation. When taking a picture, please frame only the diagram and keep the passage clear while viewing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: どの段階のお仕事探しでしょうか。応募前の相談か、面接に向けた相談かを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.translation: What stage of your job search are you at? Please tell me whether you want advice before applying or in preparation for an interview.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 応募は済んで、三日後に面接があります。自己紹介を声に出して練習する相談を、それより前に予約したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.hintJa: 応募済みで三日後の面接前に自己紹介の発話練習を予約したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.translation: I have already applied and have an interview in three days. I would like to book a consultation before then to practice my self-introduction aloud.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have already applied and want to book spoken self-introduction practice before an interview in three days.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 面接前の練習をご希望ですね。予約の候補を探すため、来られる時間帯を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.translation: You would like practice before the interview, then. Please tell me when you can come so that I can look for possible appointments.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 勤務は正午に終わりますが、ここまで移動があるので、午後一時以降でないと来られません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.hintJa: 勤務は正午終了でも移動があるため来訪は午後一時以降と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.translation: Work finishes at noon, but I need time to travel here, so I cannot arrive before one in the afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that although work ends at noon, travel means you can only come from one in the afternoon onward.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 午後一時以降の希望として確認します。履歴書の添削ではなく、話す練習を中心にしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.translation: I will check for appointments after one in the afternoon. May we focus on speaking practice rather than correcting your resume?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 話す練習が中心です。質問を聞き取れないとき、聞き返す言い方も練習したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.hintJa: 添削ではなく話す練習と、質問が聞き取れない際の聞き返しも希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.translation: Speaking practice is my main aim. I also want to practice how to ask for a question to be repeated when I cannot catch it.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want speaking practice rather than proofreading and also want to practice asking for clarification when you cannot hear a question clearly.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: その希望も伝えます。説明は日本語で進める想定ですが、特に希望する支援はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.translation: I will pass on that request too. We expect to proceed in Japanese; is there any particular support you would like?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: まず簡単な日本語で一問ずつお願いしたいです。通訳を付けるより、自分で聞き返して答える練習を希望します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.hintJa: 通訳より簡単な日本語で一問ずつ自分で聞き返して答える練習を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.translation: First, I would like simple Japanese, one question at a time. Rather than using an interpreter, I want to practice asking for clarification and answering myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you prefer practicing your own clarification and answers to one question at a time in simple Japanese rather than using an interpreter.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 承りました。面接前に枠が取れるかはまだわかりません。空き状況を確認して、こちらで結果をお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.translation: Understood. We do not yet know whether an appointment is available before your interview. We will check availability and let you know the result here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 面接までに予約できると決まったわけではないのですね。三日後の面接時刻が書かれた案内を見せて、取れる日時を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.hintJa: 予約未確定と理解し、三日後の面接時刻の案内を見せて取れる相談日時を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.translation: So an appointment before the interview has not been guaranteed. I will show you the notice with the interview time in three days and check what consultation dates and times are available.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand the booking is unconfirmed, and show the interview-time notice to check available consultation times before the interview in three days.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 案内を拝見してから候補を照合します。ご希望の練習内容と午後一時以降という条件を記録しますので、お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-05-001-SHAR.translation: I will compare the possible appointments after looking at the notice. Please wait while I record your requested practice and the condition that it must be after one in the afternoon.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 税の封筒をお持ちですね。同封されている文書の件名を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.translation: You have a tax-related envelope. Could you show me the subject heading on the enclosed document?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 封筒だけ見て、お金を払う通知だと思って来ました。中の文書には「資料の追加提出について」とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.hintJa: 封筒から支払い通知と思ったが文書件名は資料追加提出だったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.translation: I came thinking it was a payment notice just from looking at the envelope. The document inside says “Submission of additional supporting materials.”
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you thought the envelope contained a payment notice, but the document's subject is submission of additional materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 件名は資料の提出をお願いする内容ですね。ただ、具体的に何を求めているかは本文も確認しましょう。添付の用紙はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.translation: The subject heading is a request for documents. However, let us also check the main text to see exactly what is requested. Are there any attached forms?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 用紙が二枚あります。一枚目は名前を書けますが、二枚目の「対象期間」がどの期間なのかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.hintJa: 用紙二枚があり名前は書けるが二枚目の対象期間が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.translation: There are two forms. I can write my name on the first, but I do not know which period “Applicable period” on the second refers to.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that there are two forms and you can enter your name, but the applicable period on the second is unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 書類ごとに対象期間を確認する必要があります。お手元の資料には、対応しそうな期間が書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.translation: The applicable period needs to be checked for each document. Do any materials you have state a period that might correspond to it?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 勤務先の資料に開始と終了の月はありますが、同じ期間を指すか判断できません。この用紙の担当に照合してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.hintJa: 勤務先資料に開始終了月はあるが一致するか不明で担当の照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.translation: The materials from my workplace have a starting and ending month, but I cannot tell whether they mean the same period. I would like the person responsible for this form to compare them.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your workplace materials have starting and ending months but you do not know if they match, and ask the responsible staff to compare them.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 件名と連絡欄を見て、照合する担当を確認します。わからない期間を推測して記入するのは待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.translation: I will check the subject and contact section to find the responsible person. Please wait before entering a period you are unsure about based on a guess.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 期間の欄は空けたまま相談します。提出日が近いので、不明な箇所がある場合の連絡方法も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.hintJa: 対象期間は推測で書かず、提出日が近いため不明箇所の連絡方法も聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.translation: I will leave the period field blank when I consult them. Since the submission date is close, I also want to ask how to contact them about unclear parts.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not guess the period and want to ask how to report unclear sections because the submission date is near.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: その点も担当へ引き継ぎます。相談しただけで提出日が延びるわけではありません。封筒と用紙はすべてお持ちですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.translation: I will pass on that point too. Asking for advice alone does not extend the submission date. You have brought the whole envelope and all the forms, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 封筒と二枚の用紙、勤務先の資料を一緒に見せます。期間の照合と、提出日までに何を連絡するかを担当に尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.hintJa: 封筒・二枚の用紙・勤務先資料を提示し、期間照合と提出日までの連絡内容を尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.translation: I will show the envelope, both forms, and the workplace materials together. I will ask the responsible person to compare the periods and tell me what I need to communicate before the submission date.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will present the envelope, two forms, and workplace materials, and ask about matching the periods and what to communicate by the submission date.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: では書類一式をお手元に置いてお待ちください。本文の連絡先を確認し、ご質問の二点を伝えて取り次ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-06-001-SHAR.translation: Then please wait with the complete set of documents at hand. I will check the contact details in the main text and pass on your two questions.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 今日は農具を使う前の相談を受け付けます。戻ってきた道具の記録をお願いしたいのですが、担当の説明は受けましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.translation: Today we are handling inquiries before agricultural tools are used. I would like you to record tools that have been returned; have you received the responsible person's explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 受付の記録と聞きましたが、切れにくいというはさみを自分で試すところまで担当するのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.hintJa: 受付記録の担当だが切れにくいはさみを試す作業まで含むか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.translation: I heard I would be recording reception details, but does my role also include testing scissors reported not to cut well myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether your reception-recording role includes testing scissors reported as difficult to cut with.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 切れ味を試したり修理したりする担当ではありません。使った方の申告を聞いて、道具を特定する情報を記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.translation: You are not responsible for testing sharpness or making repairs. You listen to the user's report and record information identifying the tool.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: では実際には切らず、「切れにくいとの申告」と書きます。道具の番号札が外れている場合は、何を記録しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.hintJa: 実際に切らず申告として記録し、番号札が外れた場合の記入内容を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.translation: Then I will not actually cut anything; I will write “Reported as difficult to cut with.” If the tool's number tag has come off, what should I record?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will record the complaint rather than test cutting, and ask what to enter if the number tag has come off.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 番号は推測せず、外れていることを記録して私へ知らせてください。持ち主がわかるかも、聞ける範囲で確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.translation: Do not guess the number. Record that the tag is detached and tell me. Let us also check who owns it as far as you are able to ask.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 持ち主の名前は聞けますが、似たはさみが二本あります。番号札をどちらかに付け直すのは待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.hintJa: 持ち主の名は聞けるが似たはさみ二本で区別がつかず札の付け直しを待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.translation: I can ask the owner's name, but there are two similar pairs of scissors. I will wait before putting the number tag back on either one.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you can ask the owner's name but cannot distinguish two similar pairs of scissors, so you will not reattach the tag yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: はい、私が確認します。刃先に触れて違いを調べたり、開閉して確かめたりしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.translation: Yes, I will check them. Please do not touch the blades to look for differences or open and close them to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 見た目で決めず、二本あることだけを報告します。修理が終わったと相手に伝えるのも、私の担当ではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.hintJa: 見た目で決めず二本あると報告し、修理完了の案内も担当外か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.translation: I will not decide from their appearance; I will only report that there are two. Telling the other person that repairs are finished is not my responsibility either, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not decide by appearance and will report the two pairs, and confirm that announcing repair completion is also outside your role.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: そのとおりです。修理の判断や完了の案内は修理担当が行います。受付で引き継ぐ内容は整理できましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.translation: That is correct. The repair staff judge repairs and announce completion. Have you organized what reception needs to pass on?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 持ち主の申告、切れにくいという相談、番号札が外れて二本を特定できない点を記録し、修理担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.hintJa: 持ち主の申告・切れにくさ・札なしで二本を特定できない点を記録して修理担当へ引き継ぐと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.translation: I will record the owner's account, the complaint about poor cutting, and the fact that the detached tag prevents identifying the two pairs, then pass it to the repair staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will record the owner's account, poor cutting, and the inability to identify the two untagged pairs, then pass this to the repair staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: その内容で記録を一緒に確認しましょう。道具には手を加えず、今の二本の照合は私に任せて、記録用紙をこちらへお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-07-001-SHAR.translation: Let us check the record together with those details. Do not alter the tools; leave matching the two pairs to me and bring the record sheet here, please.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 振込についてお困りでしょうか。お手元の紙を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.translation: Are you having trouble with a bank transfer? Could you show me the paper you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 昨日、家賃を振り込む操作をしましたが、相手からまだわからないと言われました。この控えがあるので、もう一度払うか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.hintJa: 昨日家賃の振込操作をしたが相手が確認できず、控えを示して再送を迷っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.translation: Yesterday I carried out a transfer operation for my rent, but the recipient says they still cannot confirm it. I have this receipt, so I am unsure whether to pay again.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you operated a rent transfer yesterday but the recipient cannot confirm it, and show the receipt while explaining your uncertainty about sending again.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: もう一度行う前に、最初の手続きの状況を調べましょう。控えには「受付」とありますが、それだけで振込完了とは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.translation: Before doing it again, let us check the status of the first transaction. The receipt says “Received,” but that alone does not establish that the transfer is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 受付と完了は違うのですね。昨日の金額と振込先が書かれた画面も保存しているので、一緒に見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.hintJa: 受付と完了の違いを理解し、昨日の金額と振込先の保存画面も見てもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.translation: So receipt and completion are different. I also saved a screen showing yesterday's amount and recipient; could you look at it together with the receipt?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand receipt differs from completion and ask the staff to also look at the saved screen showing yesterday's amount and recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: はい、照会の参考に拝見します。ただ、画像と控えを見ただけではなく、実際の記録の確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.translation: Yes, I will look at it as a reference for the inquiry. However, we need to check the actual records, not just look at the image and receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 記録がわかるまでは、同じ金額をもう一度送らないようにします。照会を頼む場合にも費用がかかるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.hintJa: 記録確認まで同額の再送をせず、照会依頼に費用があるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.translation: I will not send the same amount again until the records are clear. I would also like to know whether requesting an inquiry costs anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not resend the same amount before the records are checked, and ask whether the inquiry has a fee.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 費用の有無や必要な手続きは、照会内容を確認してご案内します。ここで一律に無料とはお答えできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.translation: We will explain any fees and required procedures after checking the nature of the inquiry. I cannot say here that all such inquiries are free.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 費用の説明を聞いてから依頼します。もし最初の手続きが進んでいるなら、今日の二回目の振込は不要かもしれないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.hintJa: 費用説明後に照会を頼むと伝え、最初の手続きが進んでいれば二回目不要の可能性を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.translation: I will request it after hearing the fee explanation. If the first transaction is going through, a second transfer today might not be necessary, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will request the inquiry after hearing the fees and confirm that a second transfer may be unnecessary if the first is proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 記録の結果と契約先への確認を踏まえてご判断ください。今は新しい振込は受け付けず、昨日の状況を確かめる相談として進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.translation: Please decide based on the record-checking result and confirmation with the party you have the contract with. For now, we will not process a new transfer and will treat this as a consultation to check yesterday's status.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 新しい振込は頼みません。昨日の受付控えと保存画面で状況を確かめ、結果を聞いてから相手へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.hintJa: 新規振込は頼まず、昨日の控えと画面で状況を確認して結果後に相手へ連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.translation: I am not requesting a new transfer. I will use yesterday's receipt and saved screen to check the status, then contact the recipient after hearing the result.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not request a new transfer and will check yesterday's status using the receipt and saved screen before contacting the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず照会に必要な情報と費用の案内を確認します。控えをお手元に置き、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-08-001-SHAR.translation: Understood. First I will check the information and fee guidance needed for the inquiry. Please keep the receipt with you and wait here.

DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展望場所へ向かわれますか。今日は雨上がりなので、通路の掲示もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you going to the viewing area? Since it has just rained today, please also check the notices along the path.

DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 景色を見たいのですが、靴底がすり減っていて滑りそうです。濡れた階段を通らずに見られる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 無理のない見学範囲を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to see the view, but my shoe soles are worn and seem slippery. Is there somewhere I can see it without using the wet stairs?
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Find a manageable sightseeing area and express your request in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内図の手前にも見学場所があります。奥へ向かう階段の状態は、私が今ここで安全だと言い切ることはできません。
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is also a viewing spot toward the near end of this map. I cannot say from here right now that the stairs leading further in are safe.

DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら手前の場所を見たいです。そこへ行く道にも、通行止めの区間があるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入れる経路を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I would like to look around the nearer spot. Are any sections of the route there closed too?
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm an accessible route in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日の掲示では、奥の斜面側の道に立入制限が出ています。手前の通路に入る前にも、現地の表示と足元を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Today's notice restricts access to the path along the slope further in. Before entering the nearer walkway as well, please check the signs there and the ground underfoot.

DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 斜面側には進みません。もし手前も水がたまっていたら、案内所に戻って休んでもよいですか。
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 路面に応じた退避先を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not go toward the slope. If there is standing water even on the nearer path, may I return to the information center and rest?
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese where you can retreat depending on the path conditions.

DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 戻っていただいて構いません。入口の待合で休めますが、通路をふさがないようにお願いします。
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may return. You can rest in the waiting area at the entrance, but please do not block the passage.

DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。写真を撮るときに、柵の外へ出たり段差に上がったりしてはいけないのですね。
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見学区域の規則を守る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. When taking photographs, I must not go outside the fence or climb onto a raised edge, correct?
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will follow the viewing-area rules.

DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、見学区域の内側からお願いします。撮影に気を取られず、ほかの方が通れる幅も空けてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please stay inside the viewing area. Do not become so absorbed in photography that you forget your surroundings, and leave enough width for other people to pass.

DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は手前だけ見て、足元が悪ければ引き返します。写真も立ち止まれる所で一枚にしておきます。
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日の条件に合う行動を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will only visit the nearer spot and turn back if the footing is poor. I will limit myself to one photograph at a place where I can stop safely.
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose actions appropriate to today's conditions and state them in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その範囲で様子を見ながらどうぞ。急がずお進みください。それでは、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-KGW-KANONJI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep an eye on the conditions within that area. Go slowly without rushing. Enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 参拝のご案内でしょうか。それとも御朱印についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like information about worship, or are you asking about goshuin shrine seals and inscriptions?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めて来ました。御朱印をお願いしたいのですが、先にお参りしてから受付に戻るのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手続きの順序を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is my first visit. I would like a goshuin; should I worship first and then return to reception?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese so that you understand the order of the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まずご参拝ください。そのあと、こちらの受付で御朱印について伺います。御朱印帳はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please worship first. Afterwards, we will discuss the goshuin here at reception. Do you have a goshuin book?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日は持っていません。紙でいただけるものがあるか、参拝後に聞いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持ち物に合う受付方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not brought one today. May I ask after worship whether any are available on a separate sheet of paper?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese a reception method suited to what you have brought.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 書き置きのご用意については、受付時にお確かめください。本堂の中は撮影を控えていただいています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check at reception whether prewritten sheets are available. We ask visitors to refrain from photography inside the main hall.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 中ではカメラをしまいます。お参りの途中で靴を脱ぐ場所は、どの表示を見ればわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 参拝時の行動を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will put my camera away inside. Which sign should I look for to know where to take off my shoes during the visit?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese how to behave while worshipping.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 履物を脱ぐ場所に案内があります。入口で迷われたら、上がる前に近くの係へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is guidance where footwear must be removed. If you are unsure at an entrance, please ask a nearby attendant before stepping inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 承知しました。二十分後には出発したいのですが、戻ってから待ち時間を聞いて判断してもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予定に合う受付判断をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I would like to leave in twenty minutes; may I ask about the waiting time after returning and then decide?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese how you will decide about reception in line with your schedule.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、お戻りになった時点の受付状況をご案内します。お急ぎの場合でも、順番を早めるお約束はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we will explain the reception situation when you return. Even if you are in a hurry, we cannot promise to move you ahead in the queue.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待てるかを確認してからお願いします。まず表示を見てお参りして、終わったらこの受付に戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 順序に沿って参拝と受付を進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will request it after checking whether I can wait. First I will follow the signs to worship, and afterwards I will return to this reception desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will worship and visit reception in the instructed order.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お時間に余裕を見ながらご参拝ください。境内では足元にもお気をつけて。それでは、私は受付を離れますので失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please allow enough time while worshipping. Watch your footing within the grounds too. I will now be leaving reception, so please excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 収穫を始める前に、この枝で実の選び方をご説明します。はさみはまだ袋に入れておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before harvesting starts, I will explain on this branch how to choose the fruit. Please keep the scissors in their pouch for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 赤くなった実ならどれでも採ってよいと思っていました。枝に付いている青い印にも意味がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 収穫対象の基準を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I could pick any fruit that had turned red. Does the blue mark on the branch mean something too?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese so that you understand the criteria for fruit to be harvested.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日採っていただくのは、この印のある区画の実です。色だけでは判断しにくいので、最初の一つは私と選びましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Today you will pick fruit in the section with this mark. Color alone can be difficult to judge, so let us choose the first one together.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この低い枝の実はどうですか。裏側に小さな傷があるので、採ってよいか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 傷のある実を勝手に採らない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: How about the fruit on this low branch? There is a small scratch on the back, so I want to check whether I may pick it.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not pick damaged fruit without checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その実は私が確認しますので、そのままにしてください。練習には、こちらの傷のない実を使いましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check that fruit, so please leave it as it is. Let us use this undamaged fruit for practice.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ではそちらで練習します。枝を強く引かずに、片手で実を支えて軸を切るということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実を傷つけず収穫する方法を知る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will practice with that one. Does that mean supporting the fruit with one hand and cutting the stem without pulling hard on the branch?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to harvest without damaging the fruit.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうです。切る位置を今示します。刃先を手や隣の実に向けず、急いで切らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. I will show you where to cut now. Do not point the blades toward your hand or nearby fruit, and do not rush the cut.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 上の実も気になりますが、背伸びしないと届きません。台に乗らず、届く範囲だけにしてよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 無理に高所へ手を伸ばさない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am also interested in the fruit above, but I cannot reach it without stretching onto my toes. I should avoid climbing on a platform and only pick what I can reach, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will not strain to reach high fruit.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 届かない実は残してください。切った実はかごへ静かに置き、はさみを持ったまま歩かないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please leave fruit you cannot reach. Put picked fruit gently into the basket, and do not walk around holding the scissors.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 印のある区画の低い実だけにします。次へ移るときは、はさみを閉じて袋に戻してから歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合意した対象と手順で体験を進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will only pick the low fruit in the marked section. When moving to the next place, I will close the scissors and return them to the pouch before walking.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will follow the agreed harvest area and procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 最初の一つを一緒に確認したら始めましょう。私は隣の列におりますので、困ったら呼んでください。では、また後で。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us begin after checking the first fruit together. I will be in the next row, so call me if you have any trouble. See you later.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご利用は初めてでしょうか。持ち物や館内の使い方で、わからない点はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this your first visit? Is there anything you do not understand about what you need or how to use the facility?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めてです。タオルを家に忘れましたが、受付で借りるものと買うものがあるのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 必要な持ち物を用意する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is my first time. I forgot my towel at home; are there towels to rent and others to buy at reception?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about obtaining the things you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの案内では、貸出用のバスタオルと販売用の小さいタオルを分けて表示しています。必要なものをお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: This guidance lists rental bath towels separately from small towels for sale. Please choose what you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 体を拭く大きい方は借りて、小さい方は買いたいです。料金は入浴料と一緒に払えばよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 利用料金を確認して支払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to rent the large one for drying myself and buy the small one. Should I pay for them together with admission to the baths?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the usage charges and payment in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 合計をこちらの画面で確認してからお支払いください。貸出品はお帰りの際に返していただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the total on this screen before paying. Rental items must be returned when you leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 料金を確認しました。小さいタオルを湯船に入れず、洗い場で使う、という理解で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入浴時の規則を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have checked the amount. Is it correct that I should use the small towel in the washing area and not put it in the bath?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you understand the bathing rules.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、タオルは湯船へ入れないでください。体を洗ってから入り、洗い場では使った湯が周囲へ飛ばないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please keep towels out of the bath. Wash your body before entering, and in the washing area please keep the water you use from splashing onto others.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。借りたバスタオルは脱衣所に置きたいのですが、荷物と一緒にしまう場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 脱衣所で持ち物を保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I want to leave the rented bath towel in the changing room; please tell me where to store it with my belongings.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about storing your belongings in the changing room.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 脱衣所のロッカーをご利用ください。鍵はご自身で管理し、貸出タオルを返すときは受付横の返却箱へお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use the changing-room lockers. Keep track of the key yourself, and return the rented towel to the return box beside reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ロッカーで荷物を保管して、帰りに借りた方だけ返却箱へ入れます。買った小さいタオルは持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 利用後の返却を間違えない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will store my belongings in a locker and put only the rented towel in the return box when leaving. I will take the small towel I bought home with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese how to avoid confusing the returns after using the facility.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。館内でも困ったら係へお声がけください。それでは、ゆっくりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do that. If you need help inside, ask an attendant. Enjoy a relaxing visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 棚の表示を確認されているようですね。どの商品についてお調べしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You seem to be checking the shelf label. Which product shall I check for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この「二割引」の札は、上の一個入りにも下の二個入りにも使えるのですか。並んでいてわかりにくくて。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 札と商品を対応させる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Does this “20% off” label apply both to the single item above and the pack of two below? They are side by side, so it is confusing.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese which product the label applies to.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 対象の商品名と容量を札で確認します。お手に取っているのは二個入りですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the eligible product name and size on the label. You are holding the pack of two, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。下の棚から取りましたが、札には一個分の重さのような数字が書いてあります。違う商品の札ではありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 札が別商品ではないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I took it from the lower shelf, but the label has a number that looks like the weight of one item. Could it be a label for a different product?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the label might belong to another product.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 札と商品のバーコードを照合しました。この札は二個入りセットの表示で、数字は一個あたりの容量でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have compared the label and product barcodes. This label is for the two-item set, and the number was the quantity per individual item.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二個セットが対象なのですね。会計では札の価格から二割引になるのか、すでに割引後の価格なのかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 割引後の支払額を読み取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the set of two is eligible. Please also tell me whether another twenty percent is taken off the label price at checkout or whether that price is already discounted.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to read the amount payable after the discount.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この札の金額は割引後の価格です。ここに通常価格と割引後の価格を分けて書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The amount on this label is the discounted price. The regular price and discounted price are shown separately here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二度割り引くわけではないとわかりました。ではこのセットだけ買います。一個入りは元の棚へ戻してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要な商品だけを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-KANONJI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand that it is not discounted twice. Then I will buy only this set. May I put the single item back on its original shelf?
